quiz.q: Why do we insert each stem into the vase on the right side?
quiz.explain: Placing stems on the right side helps maintain a balanced arrangement.

quiz.q: What is the main reason for checking the stem’s alignment with the vase’s center before insertion?
choices: To prevent the stem from falling out
To ensure the stem looks neat
quiz.explain: Aligning the stem with the center keeps the vase stable.

quiz.q: Why should the insertion angle be gentle?
choices: It reduces damage to the stem
It keeps the vase from tipping
quiz.explain: A gentle angle prevents the vase from tipping during insertion.

safety: Avoid over‑crowding the vase to prevent tipping.
Hold stems steady to prevent dropping.
Check alignment to keep the vase stable.
